tools.name: add_app
tools.description: Track an app by App Store ID; its name is looked up automatically. Omit appStoreId (and pass name) for a temporary app. Free plan: 1 app.

tools.name: add_keywords
tools.description: Track up to 100 keywords for an app in a store and measure rank, popularity and difficulty. Plan limit on total tracked keywords (free: 10); a batch over the limit is rejected entirely.

tools.name: refresh_app_keywords
tools.description: Measure all tracked keywords of an app now and append to history.

tools.name: get_app_keywords
tools.description: Tracked keywords of an app with latest metrics.

tools.name: get_keyword_history
tools.description: Daily rank, popularity and difficulty history of one tracked keyword (keywordId from get_app_keywords), oldest first; days without a measurement are omitted. Free plan: last 7 days.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Current plan, tracked apps, keywords and research calls in the current quota period (free: month, pro: day). A null limit means unlimited.

tools.name: search_app_store
tools.description: Live App Store search for a keyword. Returns ranked apps and difficulty; with appStoreId also that app's ranking (null = not in the returned results). Counts toward the research quota.

tools.name: get_keyword_popularity
tools.description: Popularity scores for up to 100 keywords in a store, without tracking them. Counts toward the research quota.

tools.name: get_keyword_suggestions
tools.description: Keyword ideas for an App Store app with popularity and difficulty for the selected platform. Counts toward the research quota.

tools.name: get_most_searched_keywords
tools.description: One page of the most searched keywords in a store, optionally for an App Store category id (e.g. 6013). Check `month`: data can be from an earlier month. Counts toward the research quota.

tools.name: get_competitor_keywords
tools.description: Derives 1–3 word candidates from the top 10 competitors ranking for a keyword and returns those with popularity > 5, highest first. Pass your appStoreId to exclude your own app. Counts toward the research quota.

tools.name: get_app_details
tools.description: App Store details (developer, rating, price, description, screenshots) for up to 50 App Store IDs. IDs not available in the store are omitted. Counts toward the research quota.
